This review is long overdue, but it’s something I really wanted to write to express my gratitude to Dr. Chirag Mehta for his exceptional dental work.

About three years ago, Dr. Chirag saved my third molar with a root canal that most other dentists had advised me to extract. Almost everyone I consulted before him said the tooth couldn’t be saved, but since I had already lost my first molars on both sides, I was determined not to lose another one. Dr. Chirag understood that perfectly and assured me that he would try his best to save it — and he did!

Before starting any procedure, he patiently listened to my concerns and walked me through every detail — how long it would take, what the healing period would be like, food precautions, aftercare, and even the full cost. Once everything was clear, he began the process. He always allots ample time for each patient, which is why I recommend taking a proper appointment to get his full attention.

During the root canal itself, he constantly checked in, asking if I was okay or in pain. I remember how unbearable the pain was before the treatment — I couldn’t eat anything hot or cold, and it was affecting my focus and daily life. I was also very apprehensive about the procedure because of what people said about root canal pain, but Dr. Chirag’s professionalism and calm approach made the entire experience smooth and almost painless.

His work was so good that for the next three years, I had absolutely no issues with that tooth. Recently, when a small part of the filling chipped off, I visited a few dentists near my current location — and each one of them commented, “Whoever did your root canal did a fantastic job.” That only reaffirmed my trust in Dr. Chirag’s skill.

So I actually flew back to Mumbai just to get the maintenance done by him. Even though he didn’t remember me right away as a returning patient, it didn’t change his professionalism — he explained the procedure again in detail, took the same care, and checked frequently during the process to ensure I was comfortable.

What I truly appreciate is that my molar isn’t just functionally perfect but also aesthetically natural — it blends in completely when I laugh or eat.

I have complete trust in Dr. Chirag’s expertise and integrity, and I always recommend him to friends and family. He’s one of those rare dentists who combine skill, honesty, and genuine care for his patients.

Highly recommended!
